documents.title: github.com/stretchr/testify
documents.description: Module testify is a set of packages that provide many tools for testifying that your code will behave as you intend.
documents.searchText: module testify is a set of packages that provide many tools for testifying your code will behave as you intend. contains the following packages: [github.com/stretchr/testify/assert](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/stretchr/testify/assert) package provides comprehensive assertion functions tie in to [the go testing system](https://go.dev/doc/code#testing). [github.com/stretchr/testify/require](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/stretchr/testify/require) same assertions but fatal checks. [github.com/stretchr/testify/mock](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/stretchr/testify/mock) system by which it possible mock objects and verify calls are happening expected. [github.com/stretchr/testify/suite](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/stretchr/testify/suite) basic structure using structs suites, methods on those tests. includes setup/teardown functionality way interfaces. [golangci-lint](https://golangci-lint.run/) compatible linter available called [testifylint](https://github.com/antonboom/testifylint).

documents.description: Go API for github.com/stretchr/testify across 6 packages.
documents.searchText: - [github.com/stretchr/testify](/reference/package-root.html): module testify is a set of packages that provide many tools for testifying your code will behave as you intend. [github.com/stretchr/testify/assert](/reference/pkg-assert.html): package assert provides comprehensive testing use with the normal go system. [github.com/stretchr/testify/http](/reference/pkg-http.html): deprecated: net/http/httptest instead. [github.com/stretchr/testify/mock](/reference/pkg-mock.html): mock system by which it possible to objects and verify calls are happening expected. [github.com/stretchr/testify/require](/reference/pkg-require.html): require implements same assertions but stops test execution when fails. [github.com/stretchr/testify/suite](/reference/pkg-suite.html): suite contains logic creating structs running methods on those tests.
